findings.title: Prevent a second run from appending samples
findings.disposition: Already prevented by exclusive-create run-started.json and the one-shot ledger; an explicit refusal before paid calls was added.

findings.title: Use adjudicated flags when verifying passes
findings.disposition: Accepted; verify.mts counts the same final flags as tally.mts.

findings.title: Separate review-call latency from plan-plus-review
findings.disposition: Accepted in the guide and ADR.

findings.title: Latency scope, ADR held-out statement, refusal attribution (three findings)
findings.disposition: Accepted after checking the ledger: 6 refusals when the review rejected the re-plan, 3 when the re-plan failed the evidence checks.

findings.title: Stop sampling after an unexpected request
findings.disposition: Accepted as a guard; the recorded run had no unexpected request.

findings.title: Make run-finished.json match the run script
findings.disposition: Declined. The artifact is what the script wrote during the run, before the guard was added; rewriting it would misstate the run. The README records the later script change.
